items.raw: 'Circles on the chart at the exact price and candle where a big liquidation happened in the last 24 hours. Red = a long was force-SOLD there, green = a short was force-BOUGHT. The bigger the circle, the bigger the position. Tap one for its size, the venue and how far it is from the price now.'
items.en: Circles on the chart at the exact price and candle where a big liquidation happened in the last 24 hours. Red = a long was force-SOLD there, green = a short was force-BOUGHT. The bigger the circle, the bigger the position. Tap one for its size, the venue and how far it is from the price now.
items.es: Círculos en el gráfico en el precio y la vela exactos donde ocurrió una gran liquidación en las últimas 24 horas. Rojo = un long fue VENDIDO a la fuerza ahí, verde = un short fue COMPRADO a la fuerza. Cuanto más grande el círculo, más grande la posición. Toca uno para ver su tamaño, el exchange y a qué distancia está del precio ahora.

items.raw: 'These are not forecasts and not a model - they are events our own collector recorded across eight exchanges. Where they cluster is where leverage actually died, and that price tends to matter again: it is where stops sat, and it is where the market proved somebody was offside. A wall of red circles under a drop is the cascade that caused it.'
items.en: These are not forecasts and not a model - they are events our own collector recorded across eight exchanges. Where they cluster is where leverage actually died, and that price tends to matter again: it is where stops sat, and it is where the market proved somebody was offside. A wall of red circles under a drop is the cascade that caused it.
items.es: No son pronósticos ni un modelo - son eventos que nuestro propio recolector registró en ocho exchanges. Donde se agrupan es donde el apalancamiento realmente murió, y ese precio suele volver a importar: ahí estaban los stops, y ahí el mercado demostró que alguien estaba del lado equivocado. Un muro de círculos rojos debajo de una caída es la cascada que la causó.

items.raw: 'Price coming back DOWN into a thick band of red circles is arriving where forced selling already happened once - either it gets absorbed and that is your level, or it breaks and the same thing happens again. Green circles above you mark where shorts were squeezed out; a move back up through them has fuel behind it.'
items.en: Price coming back DOWN into a thick band of red circles is arriving where forced selling already happened once - either it gets absorbed and that is your level, or it breaks and the same thing happens again. Green circles above you mark where shorts were squeezed out; a move back up through them has fuel behind it.
items.es: El precio volviendo a BAJAR hacia una banda densa de círculos rojos está llegando a donde ya hubo venta forzada una vez - o se absorbe y ese es tu nivel, o se rompe y pasa lo mismo otra vez. Los círculos verdes por encima marcan donde los shorts fueron exprimidos; un movimiento de vuelta al alza a través de ellos tiene combustible detrás.

items.raw: 'The mirror. Shorting into a band of green circles means shorting where short positions were already force-closed once. The emptier the chart, the calmer the market has been - which is information too.'
items.en: The mirror. Shorting into a band of green circles means shorting where short positions were already force-closed once. The emptier the chart, the calmer the market has been - which is information too.
items.es: El espejo. Abrir un short hacia una banda de círculos verdes significa hacerlo donde posiciones short ya fueron cerradas a la fuerza una vez. Cuanto más vacío el gráfico, más tranquilo ha estado el mercado - lo cual también es información.

items.raw: 'One line between 0 and 100. The shaded areas are above 70 and below 30.'
items.en: One line between 0 and 100. The shaded areas are above 70 and below 30.
items.es: Una línea entre 0 y 100. Las zonas sombreadas están por encima de 70 y por debajo de 30.

items.raw: 'How much of the last 14 candles went up against down. Above 70 the move is stretched, below 30 it is washed out. A divergence - price prints a new high but RSI does not - means the move is running on fewer buyers.'
items.en: How much of the last 14 candles went up against down. Above 70 the move is stretched, below 30 it is washed out. A divergence - price prints a new high but RSI does not - means the move is running on fewer buyers.
items.es: Cuánto de las últimas 14 velas subió frente a bajó. Por encima de 70 el movimiento está estirado, por debajo de 30 está agotado. Una divergencia - el precio marca un nuevo máximo pero el RSI no - significa que el movimiento avanza con menos compradores.

items.raw: 'A turn up out of the oversold area, or a pullback that holds above 40 in an uptrend. Buying at 75 is buying the stretch.'
items.en: A turn up out of the oversold area, or a pullback that holds above 40 in an uptrend. Buying at 75 is buying the stretch.
items.es: Un giro al alza saliendo de la zona de sobreventa, o un retroceso que se mantiene por encima de 40 en una tendencia alcista. Comprar en 75 es comprar el estiramiento.

items.raw: 'A turn down out of the overbought area, or a bounce that fails under 60 in a downtrend. Shorting at 25 is shorting the washout.'
items.en: A turn down out of the overbought area, or a bounce that fails under 60 in a downtrend. Shorting at 25 is shorting the washout.
items.es: Un giro a la baja saliendo de la zona de sobrecompra, o un rebote que falla por debajo de 60 en una tendencia bajista. Abrir un short en 25 es shortear el agotamiento.

items.raw: 'Two lines and a histogram around zero. The bars are the gap between the lines.'
items.en: Two lines and a histogram around zero. The bars are the gap between the lines.
items.es: Dos líneas y un histograma alrededor de cero. Las barras son la distancia entre las líneas.

items.raw: 'Momentum. The MACD line crossing above the signal line is momentum turning up; the histogram shrinking while price still rises is momentum fading before price shows it.'
items.en: Momentum. The MACD line crossing above the signal line is momentum turning up; the histogram shrinking while price still rises is momentum fading before price shows it.
items.es: Momento. La línea MACD cruzando por encima de la línea de señal es el momento girando al alza; el histograma reduciéndose mientras el precio sigue subiendo es el momento debilitándose antes de que el precio lo muestre.

items.raw: 'A bull cross from below zero is the strongest form; a cross far above zero is late. Rising bars confirm, shrinking bars warn.'
items.en: A bull cross from below zero is the strongest form; a cross far above zero is late. Rising bars confirm, shrinking bars warn.
items.es: Un cruce alcista desde debajo de cero es la forma más fuerte; un cruce muy por encima de cero llega tarde. Las barras creciendo confirman, las barras reduciéndose advierten.

items.raw: 'A bear cross from above zero. A histogram that peaks and shrinks while price makes a higher high is the classic exhaustion.'
items.en: A bear cross from above zero. A histogram that peaks and shrinks while price makes a higher high is the classic exhaustion.
items.es: Un cruce bajista desde encima de cero. Un histograma que alcanza un pico y se reduce mientras el precio marca un máximo más alto es el agotamiento clásico.

items.raw: '%K (fast) and %D (slow) between 0 and 100, with shaded areas above 80 and below 20.'
items.en: %K (fast) and %D (slow) between 0 and 100, with shaded areas above 80 and below 20.
items.es: %K (rápida) y %D (lenta) entre 0 y 100, con zonas sombreadas por encima de 80 y por debajo de 20.

items.raw: 'Where the close sits inside the recent range. High = closing near the top of the range, low = near the bottom. In a strong trend it can stay pinned for a long time - that is the trend, not a signal.'
items.en: Where the close sits inside the recent range. High = closing near the top of the range, low = near the bottom. In a strong trend it can stay pinned for a long time - that is the trend, not a signal.
items.es: Dónde se ubica el cierre dentro del rango reciente. Alto = cerrando cerca de la parte superior del rango, bajo = cerca de la inferior. En una tendencia fuerte puede quedar clavado ahí mucho tiempo - eso es la tendencia, no una señal.

items.raw: '%K crossing above %D inside the lower area, in an uptrend. Not a long because it is low: because it turned.'
items.en: %K crossing above %D inside the lower area, in an uptrend. Not a long because it is low: because it turned.
items.es: %K cruzando por encima de %D dentro de la zona baja, en una tendencia alcista. No es un long porque está bajo: es porque giró.

items.raw: '%K crossing below %D inside the upper area, in a downtrend.'
items.en: %K crossing below %D inside the upper area, in a downtrend.
items.es: %K cruzando por debajo de %D dentro de la zona alta, en una tendencia bajista.

items.raw: 'One line in price units: the average candle range over 14 candles.'
items.en: One line in price units: the average candle range over 14 candles.
items.es: Una línea en unidades de precio: el rango medio de vela en las últimas 14 velas.

items.raw: 'How far this market moves per candle right now. It sizes stops and targets - a stop inside one ATR is noise and gets hit by nothing.'
items.en: How far this market moves per candle right now. It sizes stops and targets - a stop inside one ATR is noise and gets hit by nothing.
items.es: Cuánto se mueve este mercado por vela ahora mismo. Sirve para calcular stops y objetivos - un stop dentro de un ATR es ruido y lo toca cualquier cosa.

items.raw: 'Put the stop at least 1.5 ATR under the entry level, and size the position so that distance is the risk you accept.'
items.en: Put the stop at least 1.5 ATR under the entry level, and size the position so that distance is the risk you accept.
items.es: Pon el stop al menos a 1.5 ATR por debajo del nivel de entrada, y calcula el tamaño de la posición para que esa distancia sea el riesgo que aceptas.

items.raw: 'The same above the entry. A rising ATR into your target means the target can be reached faster, and the stop too.'
items.en: The same above the entry. A rising ATR into your target means the target can be reached faster, and the stop too.
items.es: Lo mismo por encima de la entrada. Un ATR en aumento hacia tu objetivo significa que puede alcanzarse más rápido, y el stop también.

items.raw: 'One line between -100 and 0. Shaded above -20 and below -80.'
items.en: One line between -100 and 0. Shaded above -20 and below -80.
items.es: Una línea entre -100 y 0. Sombreado por encima de -20 y por debajo de -80.

items.raw: 'The mirror of the stochastic: where the close sits in the 14-candle range. Above -20 price closes near the highs, below -80 near the lows.'
items.en: The mirror of the stochastic: where the close sits in the 14-candle range. Above -20 price closes near the highs, below -80 near the lows.
items.es: El espejo del estocástico: dónde se ubica el cierre en el rango de 14 velas. Por encima de -20 el precio cierra cerca de los máximos, por debajo de -80 cerca de los mínimos.

items.raw: 'A climb out of the lower area while structure holds. A reading that refuses to leave -90 is a falling knife.'
items.en: A climb out of the lower area while structure holds. A reading that refuses to leave -90 is a falling knife.
items.es: Una subida saliendo de la zona baja mientras la estructura se mantiene. Una lectura que se niega a salir de -90 es un cuchillo cayendo.

items.raw: 'A drop out of the upper area. Pinned at -10 in a strong trend is strength, not a short.'
items.en: A drop out of the upper area. Pinned at -10 in a strong trend is strength, not a short.
items.es: Una caída saliendo de la zona alta. Clavado en -10 en una tendencia fuerte es fuerza, no una señal de short.

items.raw: 'One line around zero. Shaded past +100 and -100.'
items.en: One line around zero. Shaded past +100 and -100.
items.es: Una línea alrededor de cero. Sombreado más allá de +100 y -100.

items.raw: 'How far the typical price sits from its 20-candle average, scaled by its usual deviation. Beyond 100 the market is stretched from its mean.'
items.en: How far the typical price sits from its 20-candle average, scaled by its usual deviation. Beyond 100 the market is stretched from its mean.
items.es: A qué distancia está el precio típico de su promedio de 20 velas, ajustado por su desviación habitual. Más allá de 100 el mercado está estirado respecto a su media.

items.raw: 'Bars in the candle colour. The card compares the newest bar with the 20-bar average.'
items.en: Bars in the candle colour. The card compares the newest bar with the 20-bar average.
items.es: Barras en el color de la vela. La tarjeta compara la barra más reciente con el promedio de 20 barras.

items.raw: 'Participation. A move on 2x average volume has people behind it; a breakout on half the average usually comes back.'
items.en: Participation. A move on 2x average volume has people behind it; a breakout on half the average usually comes back.
items.es: Participación. Un movimiento con 2x el volumen promedio tiene gente detrás; una ruptura con la mitad del promedio suele volver atrás.

items.raw: 'A breakout candle at 1.5x or more, and a pullback that goes quiet. Rising price on falling volume is a move running out of buyers.'
items.en: A breakout candle at 1.5x or more, and a pullback that goes quiet. Rising price on falling volume is a move running out of buyers.
items.es: Una vela de ruptura con 1.5x o más, y un retroceso que se calma. Precio subiendo con volumen cayendo es un movimiento quedándose sin compradores.

items.raw: 'A breakdown on volume, a bounce on none. A selling climax (3x and more, long wick) often ends the fall rather than starts it.'
items.en: A breakdown on volume, a bounce on none. A selling climax (3x and more, long wick) often ends the fall rather than starts it.
items.es: Una ruptura a la baja con volumen, un rebote sin él. Un clímax de ventas (3x o más, mecha larga) suele terminar la caída más que iniciarla.

items.raw: 'A score from 0 to 100 with its band shaded past 90, and which side the liquidation fuel sits on.'
items.en: A score from 0 to 100 with its band shaded past 90, and which side the liquidation fuel sits on.
items.es: Una puntuación de 0 a 100 con su banda sombreada más allá de 90, y de qué lado está el combustible de liquidación.

items.raw: 'Liquidation fuel within 5% of price against what 20 candles of volume can absorb, ranked against the last 200 candles. Above 70 the market is fragile, above 90 one push can cascade.'
items.en: Liquidation fuel within 5% of price against what 20 candles of volume can absorb, ranked against the last 200 candles. Above 70 the market is fragile, above 90 one push can cascade.
items.es: Combustible de liquidación dentro del 5% del precio frente a lo que pueden absorber 20 velas de volumen, clasificado contra las últimas 200 velas. Por encima de 70 el mercado es frágil, por encima de 90 un solo empujón puede generar una cascada.

items.raw: 'Fuel BELOW price under a long is a chain of long liquidations - keep the stop beyond it or wait for it to clear. Fuel above price is your target.'
items.en: Fuel BELOW price under a long is a chain of long liquidations - keep the stop beyond it or wait for it to clear. Fuel above price is your target.
items.es: Combustible POR DEBAJO del precio con un long es una cadena de liquidaciones long - mantén el stop más allá de ella o espera a que se despeje. El combustible por encima del precio es tu objetivo.

items.raw: 'Fuel ABOVE price under a short is a short squeeze waiting for a push. Fuel below is where a short can run.'
items.en: Fuel ABOVE price under a short is a short squeeze waiting for a push. Fuel below is where a short can run.
items.es: Combustible POR ENCIMA del precio con un short es un short squeeze esperando un empujón. El combustible por debajo es hasta donde puede llegar un short.

items.raw: 'A score from -100 to +100 with the strong-lean bands shaded past +55 and -55, and the factors driving it now.'
items.en: A score from -100 to +100 with the strong-lean bands shaded past +55 and -55, and the factors driving it now.
items.es: Una puntuación de -100 a +100 con las bandas de sesgo fuerte sombreadas más allá de +55 y -55, y los factores que la impulsan ahora.

items.raw: 'Eight factors - trend, momentum, volume, fragility, real liquidation flow, funding, crowd positioning, structure - blended with weights re-learned every 10 candles from the trailing 280, never the future. Beyond 55 the model sees a one-sided market.'
items.en: Eight factors - trend, momentum, volume, fragility, real liquidation flow, funding, crowd positioning, structure - blended with weights re-learned every 10 candles from the trailing 280, never the future. Beyond 55 the model sees a one-sided market.
items.es: Ocho factores - tendencia, momento, volumen, fragilidad, flujo real de liquidación, funding, posicionamiento de la multitud, estructura - combinados con pesos reaprendidos cada 10 velas a partir de las últimas 280, nunca del futuro. Más allá de 55 el modelo ve un mercado unilateral.

items.raw: 'Trade with a strong bullish lean, size down inside the band, and read the driving factors: a lean built on funding and crowd is a squeeze, one built on trend and volume is a trend.'
items.en: Trade with a strong bullish lean, size down inside the band, and read the driving factors: a lean built on funding and crowd is a squeeze, one built on trend and volume is a trend.
items.es: Opera con un sesgo alcista fuerte, reduce el tamaño dentro de la banda, y lee los factores que lo impulsan: un sesgo construido sobre funding y la multitud es un squeeze, uno construido sobre tendencia y volumen es una tendencia.

items.raw: 'The mirror. A strong bearish lean with fragility among the drivers is where cascades start.'
items.en: The mirror. A strong bearish lean with fragility among the drivers is where cascades start.
items.es: El espejo. Un sesgo bajista fuerte con fragilidad entre los factores es donde empiezan las cascadas.

items.raw: 'A 70% up-rate with a large projected move is drift in your favour; 70% with a tiny move says the edge is small.'
items.en: A 70% up-rate with a large projected move is drift in your favour; 70% with a tiny move says the edge is small.
items.es: Una tasa de subida del 70% con un movimiento proyectado grande es una deriva a tu favor; un 70% con un movimiento diminuto dice que la ventaja es pequeña.

items.raw: 'A low up-rate with a negative projection. When analogs split 50/50 the memory has nothing to say - trade the structure.'
items.en: A low up-rate with a negative projection. When analogs split 50/50 the memory has nothing to say - trade the structure.
items.es: Una tasa de subida baja con una proyección negativa. Cuando los análogos se dividen 50/50 la memoria no tiene nada que decir - opera según la estructura.

items.raw: 'The dominant liquidation pool above and below price, and a bar showing which way the pull leans right now.'
items.en: The dominant liquidation pool above and below price, and a bar showing which way the pull leans right now.
items.es: El pool de liquidación dominante por encima y por debajo del precio, y una barra que muestra hacia dónde se inclina la atracción ahora mismo.

items.raw: 'Size x proximity of the standing pools from our leverage-ladder model. Price tends to visit the stronger pool - it is where forced orders wait.'
items.en: Size x proximity of the standing pools from our leverage-ladder model. Price tends to visit the stronger pool - it is where forced orders wait.
items.es: Tamaño x proximidad de los pools existentes según nuestro modelo de escalera de apalancamiento. El precio suele visitar el pool más fuerte - ahí esperan las órdenes forzadas.

items.raw: 'A pool above is a target. A pool just below is the level to keep a stop beyond, because the sweep through it is the most common stop-out.'
items.en: A pool above is a target. A pool just below is the level to keep a stop beyond, because the sweep through it is the most common stop-out.
items.es: Un pool por encima es un objetivo. Un pool justo por debajo es el nivel en el que mantener el stop más allá, porque el barrido a través de él es el stop-out más común.

items.raw: 'A pool below is the target. A pool above is the squeeze risk - keep the stop beyond it.'
items.en: A pool below is the target. A pool above is the squeeze risk - keep the stop beyond it.
items.es: Un pool por debajo es el objetivo. Un pool por encima es el riesgo de squeeze - mantén el stop más allá de él.

An `entry` outside entryBandLow..entryBandHigh is a level price will probably never come back to, and the chart will REFUSE to draw it as a trade - it shows the reader NO POSITION NOW instead. Put the entry inside the band, or say plainly that there is no position right now and give the chart read.'
items.en: % below where it is. An `entry` outside entryBandLow..entryBandHigh is a level price will probably never come back to, and the chart will REFUSE to draw it as a trade - it shows the reader NO POSITION NOW instead. Put the entry inside the band, or say plainly that there is no position right now and give the chart read.
items.es: % por debajo de donde está. Un `entry` fuera de entryBandLow..entryBandHigh es un nivel al que el precio probablemente nunca volverá, y el gráfico SE NEGARÁ a dibujarlo como operación - en su lugar le muestra al lector SIN POSICIÓN AHORA. Pon la entrada dentro de la banda, o di claramente que no hay posición ahora mismo y da la lectura del gráfico.
